info.weight: Takeoff weight = empty weight + payload + fuel. Must not exceed MTOW (maximum takeoff weight). In advanced mode, enter weight per station for CG calculation.
info.fuel: Fuel per RBAC 91.151: trip (origin→dest) + alternate (dest→alt) + contingency (% of trip) + reserve (30 min day / 45 min night at cruise). The suggested value is auto-calculated — you can override it.
info.routeVfr: VFR route: direct (DCT) between visual reference points. Cruise altitudes follow the semicircular rule (+500 ft). TOD expressed in minutes before destination.
info.routeIfr: IFR route: SID → Airways → STAR. Cruise levels follow the semicircular rule (full thousands). TOD expressed as distance (NM) from destination using the 3:1 rule.
info.routeMixed: Mixed flight plan: indicate the change point in the route where flight rules transition. Both VFR and IFR altitude rules apply to their respective segments.

home.heroDescription: Plan VFR and IFR flights with the same precision used in real aviation. ICAO rules, REA corridors, fuel and weight calculations — all in one platform.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need for a well-planned flight
home.featVfrDesc: Plan visual routes with waypoints, geographic references and altitudes calculated by the semicircular rule. DCT support and automatic magnetic heading calculation.
home.featReaDesc: Navigation engine powered by a directed graph built from DECEA GeoAISWEB data. Computes optimal routes via Dijkstra, respects one-way restrictions, compulsory altitudes and automatically selects entry and exit gates.
home.featFuelDesc: Complete calculation: trip + alternate + contingency (%) + reserve (30 min day / 45 min night). Tank capacity warnings and endurance.
home.featWeightDesc: Enter weight per station in advanced mode. Validation against MTOW (max takeoff weight) and available useful load calculation.
home.featSimbriefDesc: Import your OFP directly or open SimBrief dispatch with pre-filled route data.
home.featChartsDesc: Access ADC, VAC and PDC charts from DECEA. Export your complete flight plan as PDF with checklist and charts attached.
home.methodSemiDesc: VFR cruise altitudes follow the semicircular rule: magnetic headings 0-179° use odd altitudes +500 ft (3,500, 5,500, 7,500...) and 180-359° use even +500 ft (4,500, 6,500, 8,500...). South-split regions (090-269° / 270-089°) are supported.
home.methodFuelDesc: Per RBAC 91.151: trip fuel (origin → destination) + alternate fuel (destination → alternate) + contingency (percentage of trip) + final reserve (30 minutes day / 45 minutes night at cruise power).
home.methodReaDesc: The REA engine builds a directed graph from official DECEA GeoAISWEB segments (ICA:CV_REA_BR_COMPLETO layer). Each segment defines edge directionality — permitted direction creates an edge, null heading blocks it. Dijkstra's algorithm finds the shortest route respecting direction, altitude and corridor type constraints (mandatory vs recommended). Entry and exit gates are selected automatically based on aerodrome positions and graph topology.
home.aiTitle: AI Instructor reviews your flight plan
home.aiDescription: Before takeoff, submit your plan for a comprehensive review by AI trained on aviation regulations. The AI analyzes every aspect of your flight and delivers a detailed assessment in seconds — like having an instructor available 24/7.
home.aiCheckRouteDesc: Checks if the route makes operational sense, analyzes waypoints, distances between visual references and diversion alternatives.
home.aiCheckWeatherDesc: Cross-references METAR and TAF with VMC requirements for each flight phase, alerting about marginal or prohibitive conditions.
home.aiCheckFuelDesc: Validates if fuel on board meets regulatory minimums including day/night reserve and alternate fuel.
home.aiCheckAirspaceDesc: Analyzes TMAs, CTRs, REA corridors and conditional airspaces along the planned route.
home.aiCheckRegulationsDesc: Verifies compliance with ICA 100-12, RBAC 91.151, semicircular rule and VFR altitude limits.
home.aiCheckRiskDesc: Identifies the main flight threats and provides objective mitigation recommendations for each scenario.
home.aiStep1Desc: Fill in origin, destination, aircraft, route and fuel as usual in the VFR form.
home.aiStep2Desc: Click 'Analyze with AI' — the AI receives all your plan data, including real-time weather.
home.aiStep3Desc: In seconds, receive a categorized analysis with per-item status (pass, warning or issue) and an executive summary.
home.exportTitle: One PDF with everything you need
home.exportDescription: Export a single professional document that consolidates all your flight information — ready to consult during briefing or take to the cockpit.
home.exportItemPlanDesc: Complete data: route, altitudes, magnetic headings, distances, estimated times and aerodrome information.
home.exportItemAiDesc: Full AI instructor assessment with per-category analysis, decision tables and executive summary.
home.exportItemChecklistDesc: Aircraft-specific checklist with items checked during planning.
home.exportItemChartsDesc: ADC, VAC and PDC charts for origin, destination and alternate aerodromes automatically attached.
home.exportItemMapDesc: Interactive map capture with the full route, waypoints and visual references plotted.
home.exportItemViabilityDesc: Regulatory validation panel with status for each check: weather, fuel, weight and airspace.
home.exportSinglePdfDesc: No need to combine files from different sources. One click generates the complete document with plan, AI analysis, checklist, official charts and map — ready to print or view on a tablet.
home.communityDesc: FS Suite is a free tool developed by virtual pilots for virtual pilots. If you enjoy it and want to help keep it running, consider buying us a coffee!
home.wxDescription: All flight-relevant weather information integrated directly into the interactive map — no need to switch between different sites and sources.
home.wxMetarDesc: Decoded METAR with plain-language translation: wind, visibility, ceiling, clouds and QNH. Visual indicator when the observation is old.
home.wxTafDesc: Terminal forecast with decoded change periods. Automatically identifies the predicted condition at your estimated arrival time.
home.wxCategoryDesc: Each aerodrome on the map displays its VFR, MVFR, IFR or LIFR category with color coding. Stations without their own METAR use the nearest one.
home.wxSigmetDesc: Significant weather polygons drawn on the map: thunderstorms, turbulence, icing and low visibility with altitude range and validity.
home.wxPrecipDesc: Global precipitation layer with radar-style color scale — from light blue (drizzle) to red (heavy rain) — refreshed every 10 minutes.
home.wxSatelliteDesc: Infrared imagery from the GOES-16 geostationary satellite overlaid on the map. Identifies high cloud formations and convective activity.
home.wxCrosswindDesc: When selecting an aerodrome, see the crosswind component analysis for each available runway with the most favorable runway highlighted.
home.reaDescription: Automatically calculates the optimal route through Brazilian REA corridors, respecting all direction and altitude restrictions published by DECEA.
home.reaStep1Desc: REA segments imported directly from GeoAISWEB via WFS. Automatic updates every AIRAC cycle.
home.reaStep2Desc: Each corridor becomes directed edges with heading, altitude and type. Gates with null heading in both directions are treated as bidirectional.
home.reaStep3Desc: The algorithm finds the shortest route between aerodromes, testing multiple arrival gates and prioritizing mandatory corridors.

home.readyDesc: Create your account for free and start planning routes like a real pilot.
